title: Validate the dossier and export the eCTD package
walkthrough:
You start on the dossier manager page, headed "Your product dossiers", with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" and chips for "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →". Each dossier is a tile showing its ID, product name, a progress bar, and a status chip reading either "Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules". Clicking a tile opens the dossier workspace at Module 1.

The workspace has a top bar with module tabs M1–M5 (each marked with a check, dash, or dot), plus chips for "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio" and "Journey". A section tree sits on the left, the document panel in the middle, and a right-hand side rail holds the cards you use for this flow. A summary card there shows a progress bar, "3/4 required sections complete" style text, and three readiness flags: "Documents", "Fee", and "Valid eCTD", each ticked or open-circled.

Below that is the "eCTD validation" card. It shows a status badge — "● PASSED" or "● 3 error(s)" — and lists findings, each prefixed with a rule code such as CA-E or CA-W. Only the first 5 errors show; a "Show all 12 errors" / "Show fewer" toggle expands the list, and extra warnings are summarized as "+4 more warning(s) — Show all above". The structural check is pre-computed; a button labeled "Run full check (PDF conformance)" (showing "Checking…" while running) runs the deeper technical validation. A footnote explains: "Findings carry Health Canada eCTD validation-rule-style IDs (CA-E-…/CA-W-…) covering leaf integrity, lifecycle legality, naming, sequence numbering, XML backbone and PDF conformance."

Above it, the "Sequences" card lists each eCTD sequence (e.g. 0000) with a purpose chip ("Response", "Supplement", "Annual notification", "Initial"), a leaf count like "2 leaf(s)", and either an "● ACTIVE" badge or a "Make active" button. The header notes the working sequence ("working: 0001"). A "New sequence" button opens a purpose dropdown, a note field placeholder "Note (e.g. screening deficiency SDN-1)", and "Create & make active" / "Cancel".

To export, you click "Export" beside a sequence. The app first re-runs validation. If it passed, the package downloads. If not, a browser confirm dialog warns, e.g., "Validation has 3 unresolved error(s)… Health Canada screening would reject this package. Export anyway for internal review?" — you must accept to download anyway. If the validator is offline, the export proceeds silently without a check.
